data.body: MERGED. Gerrit change 1458 reached LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 (both bot-cast; self-approval is not possible), 0 unresolved comments, and Gerrit reported submittable:true. Submitted via POST /a/changes/1458/submit as RebarBotNava at 2026-08-07 01:51:14 UTC; the API returned status MERGED. The merge commit is 9bdb22f5887ef4c03fed11d1fcefe952e70b3bd7 ('2cf5: ignore .provision.log') — submitted without rebase, so it is byte-identical to the pushed patchset. Confirmed independently: 'git ls-remote gerrit refs/heads/main' returns 9bdb22f5887ef4c03fed11d1fcefe952e70b3bd7, i.e. the change IS the tip of main. The GitHub mirror (origin) still shows 53b9c3e6dd because mirror replication lags Gerrit submit; that is replication latency, not a landing failure. All five ACs verified in worktree /Users/joeoakhart/gitignore-2cf5 at commit 9bdb22f588: grep -c '^\.provision\.log$' .gitignore = 1; git check-ignore -v .provision.log exits 0 attributing .gitignore:12; with .provision.log present git status --porcelain is empty post-commit; git show --name-only lists exactly .gitignore.
